command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$xs=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_04/nodes'; foreach (`$x in `$xs) { `$n=`$x.name; `$cl=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_04/nodes/'+`$n+'/commands'); `$keys=@(`$cl.commands.command_key); if (`$keys -contains 'display_current-configuration') { `$cmd='display%20current-configuration' } elseif (`$keys -contains 'show_running-config') { `$cmd='show%20running-config' } else { continue }; try { `$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_04/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$cmd)).output; `$ls=(`$o -split '\r?\n') | Where-Object { `$_ -match '(?i)\bcost\b|metric' }; if (`$ls) { Write-Output ('=== '+`$n+' ==='); `$ls } } catch {} }"
